requirements.label: Submitting the application
requirements.details: Apply online and upload the required documents through the portal. AUC waits for the complete file before a final admission decision.

requirements.label: Personal statement
requirements.details: Submit your own original personal statement. AUC checks statements for plagiarism.

requirements.label: Two recommendations
requirements.details: Enter the email addresses of two high school teachers or counsellors. They receive instructions to submit their letters directly to AUC.

requirements.label: Eligibility and selection
requirements.details: The minimum for each certificate qualifies an applicant for consideration. The cutoff can change each semester and selection depends on available places.

requirements.label: Academic English evidence
requirements.details: New undergraduate applicants must provide evidence of English proficiency with the application. Accepted tests are the international TOEFL, academic IELTS and Duolingo English Test. Take the test within two years before the first day of the intended semester. English-medium schooling or citizenship alone does not establish an exemption.

requirements.label: Sending English results
requirements.details: For TOEFL and Duolingo, have electronic scores sent directly to AUC and upload a copy. AUC’s TOEFL code is 0903. For IELTS upload the academic report including its TRF number. AUC accepts TOEFL MyBest Scores and considers IELTS One Skill Retake.

requirements.label: US diploma · academic record
requirements.details: AUC evaluates cumulative grades 9–12 and test scores. Applicants need a cumulative GPA of at least 2.0/4.0 from an accredited school and official transcripts from every school attended. Completing the diploma in 12 years of schooling receives preference.

requirements.label: US diploma · SAT or ACT
requirements.details: For general admission consideration, submit at least 950 combined on SAT I or a composite of at least 20 on ACT I. SAT English scores do not waive the English proficiency requirement.

requirements.label: US diploma · under 18 months at an accredited school
requirements.details: Applicants with less than one and a half years at an accredited American high school must also submit ACT 2 results for two different subjects of their choice, each at least 22.

requirements.label: British certificates · best eight subjects
requirements.details: AUC uses the best eight IGCSE/GCSE, AS or A-level subjects. The minimum is C at GCSE/IGCSE or AS and D at A level. For a subject taken at AS and A level, AUC counts the higher grade. Excellent grades and advanced or AS studies receive preference.

requirements.label: British certificates · official results
requirements.details: Submit every certificate and your candidate number. AUC accepts copies of results statements carrying an original school or British Council stamp. School transcripts and predicted grades are excluded from the eight-subject evaluation.

requirements.label: British certificates · Arabic as a second language
requirements.details: For Arab nationals who are native Arabic speakers, GCSE/IGCSE Arabic as a second language cannot count among the eight subjects.

requirements.label: British certificates · evidence of years in school
requirements.details: For international-system school years, supply the final grade-one report and proof for each year from primary through secondary. Applicants with six years after ibtdaya or three after idadiya provide both sides of that certificate with the academic year visible. Results showing only Arabic and religion are insufficient.

requirements.label: Canadian diplomas · overall average
requirements.details: The Dogwood, Manitoba and Ontario routes each require an average of at least 75% for university admission consideration.

requirements.label: Dogwood diploma · transcripts
requirements.details: Submit the grade 11 transcript and first semester of grade 12 for early evaluation. Submit official grades for both complete years for final review.

requirements.label: Manitoba diploma · senior courses
requirements.details: At early review, complete at least three grade 12 courses at the 40S level. At final review, the count rises to five.

requirements.label: Ontario diploma · grade 12 courses
requirements.details: For early review, four completed grade 12 U or M courses enter the average. Final review requires six.

requirements.label: French Baccalaureate · overall result
requirements.details: AUC considers an academic average of 10 (passable) or higher.

requirements.label: German Abitur · overall result
requirements.details: AUC gives an academic average of 4 on the German grading scale as the threshold for consideration.

requirements.label: IB course certificates
requirements.details: Applicants presenting IB course certificates can qualify by meeting the AUC American high school diploma or British certificate requirements. Full diploma holders follow the IB Diploma route.

requirements.label: Arab national certificate or Tawjihi
requirements.details: For the Arab-country national certificate route, AUC uses the official overall result, with at least 75% needed for consideration.

requirements.label: Egyptian national certificates
requirements.details: For Thanawiya Amma, the STEM certificate and Thanawiya Azhariya, the official overall percentage must reach 70% for general admission consideration.

requirements.label: Other secondary certificates
requirements.details: AUC lists Australian, Nova Scotia, Greek, Lebanese, and West and East African secondary certificates. Contact admissions for the applicable requirements for these or another certificate outside the detailed tables.

requirements.label: Provisional admission · final confirmation
requirements.details: Fall early admission is provisional. Complete secondary school, submit the final transcript and proof of graduation, and maintain a level of performance comparable to the provisional decision. AUC can withdraw the offer if final results fall short.

requirements.label: Provisional offer deposit
requirements.details: An early offer sets a non-refundable deposit that counts toward tuition at final admission. A final acceptance letter gives the deadline for the non-refundable tuition payment.

requirements.label: Provisional admission · English and certificate documents
requirements.details: Every published provisional route requires a complete file with English proficiency results. US diploma applicants submit grades 9–11 and satisfactory SAT I or ACT results. For British certificates, complete eight subjects, with preference for advanced-level subjects.

requirements.label: IB, French and German predicted results
requirements.details: For early admission the school completes and stamps AUC’s form with final-year predicted grades. Upload it to the application checklist. IB applicants must also submit their English results by the early deadline.

requirements.label: Renewal and late applications
requirements.details: A fall application can be renewed by email for spring of the same academic year. A new academic year needs a new application. Late consideration depends on remaining places.

requirements.label: Engineering major · application choice
requirements.details: Enter your intended engineering major on the application. The programme prerequisites are used for consideration while places are available.

requirements.label: English placement · exemption routes
requirements.details: For placement, AUC lists four consecutive final school years taught in English in a country with English as an official language, qualifying English-medium studies for advanced placement including the IB Diploma, or successful non-remedial university English study. The placement page also requires test results for an applicant who does not attend an English-language university in an English-speaking country. Applicants should confirm their exemption with AUC.

requirements.label: AP English Language and Composition · placement
requirements.details: A score of 4 or 5 can qualify for an English placement exemption and transfer credit. This is conditional on AUC’s placement review.

requirements.label: English placement · intensive study
requirements.details: AUC uses the highest TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo result for placement. An admitted student may be offered Intensive English or English for the Liberal Arts before rhetoric and composition. Each bridge has a completion window of at most two full semesters and one summer session.

requirements.label: AP exams · advanced credit
requirements.details: AUC awards transfer credit for academic Advanced Placement exams scored 4 or 5 out of 5.

requirements.label: IB Diploma · advanced credit
requirements.details: AUC lists up to 30 transfer credits for diploma holders, with HL academic subjects at 5–7 eligible. A diploma total of at least 30 can earn up to 15 lower-division general elective credits. SL subjects receive no transfer credit. The 30-point figure is for credit.

requirements.label: GCE · advanced credit
requirements.details: A-level academic subjects at A or B can earn credit. AS, AO and O levels are ineligible for credit under this policy.

requirements.label: Abitur · advanced credit
requirements.details: Academic subjects graded at least 10/15 can earn up to 30 transfer credits.

requirements.label: French Baccalaureate II · advanced credit
requirements.details: Advanced-level academic subjects graded at least 14/20 can earn up to 30 transfer credits.

profiles.notes: The certificate, major and route named in each requirement determine its scope. Year-specific dates refer to the stated AUC intake.

requirements.label: University transfer · GPA and 60-hour rule
requirements.details: For transfer from an accredited university, the minimum GPA is 2.0/4.0. With fewer than 60 credit hours graded at least C on AUC’s scale, admission is evaluated using secondary school qualifications. With at least 60 such hours, AUC evaluates the current university GPA.

requirements.label: Major declaration after transferring
requirements.details: Transfer entrants start undeclared. A department considers declaration based on transferred hours and its own requirements.

requirements.label: Transfer credit documentation
requirements.details: Submit the official transcript and course syllabi or descriptions. The academic department determines course equivalence and the amount of credit.

requirements.label: Credit from a previous university
requirements.details: The sending US institution must hold regional accreditation. Outside the US, AUC requires recognition by the relevant Ministry of Higher Education or Supreme Council of Universities. Eligible university coursework requires at least the equivalent of C. US C− and grades of Pass, Credit or Satisfactory are ineligible.

requirements.label: Credit age and previous awards
requirements.details: AUC excludes coursework completed more than five years before enrolment and credits used toward a prior degree. Accepted credits add earned hours and do not enter the AUC GPA.

requirements.label: Coursework elsewhere after matriculation
requirements.details: After AUC matriculation, the maximum is 36 semester hours in transfer, with up to 12 in any one summer and at most nine from online or distance courses. Outside courses overlapping an enrolled AUC term are ineligible. Host institutions send transcripts directly to AUC.
